elements.description: Suggestions for an empty chat and follow-ups after an answer, as a list that fills the composer or sends.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading above the list, and the list's accessible name

properties.name: variant
properties.description: "starters" for an empty chat (icon tiles and hints), or "follow-ups" after an answer (compact rows)

properties.name: groups
properties.description: Suggestions in groups, each with a heading and an icon

properties.name: items
properties.description: Suggestions without groups – shown after any groups

properties.name: mode
properties.description: What choosing a suggestion does unless it says otherwise: "send" it, or "fill" the composer to edit first

properties.name: loading
properties.description: The suggestions are being worked out: placeholder rows instead of the list

properties.name: hints
properties.description: Show the key hints under the list (↵ and →)

properties.name: sendLabel
properties.description: The word for sending in the key hint and the screen-reader text

properties.name: fillLabel
properties.description: The word for filling the composer in the key hint and the screen-reader text

properties.name: emptyText
properties.description: Text when there are no suggestions (and not loading); empty hides the element's list entirely

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-send
events.description: A suggestion was chosen to send as it is ({ text, item, group })

events.name: tc-fill
events.description: A suggestion was chosen to put in the composer and edit first ({ text, item, group })

props.name: title
props.description: The heading above the list, and the list's accessible name

props.name: groups
props.description: Suggestions in groups, each with a heading and an icon

props.name: items
props.description: Suggestions without groups – shown after any groups

props.name: onSend
props.description: Called with the text when a suggestion is chosen to send as it is

props.name: onFill
props.description: Called with the text when a suggestion is chosen to fill the composer – put it there and focus it
